prompts.name: zombie_apple

Input 2 is the current 3-apple sheet, an edit target for only the named item. Render just ONE edited apple, not a sheet. Crisp pixel art, strong tiny-grid readable clusters, transparent background, no lettering, no border, no anti-aliasing or smooth gradients. Edit the Zombie Apple (left item): use the exact vanilla apple silhouette, no bite missing from its outline. Preserve rotten olive-green coloring, moss-light highlights and restrained brown-green bruise pixels. Make the body round like vanilla, not a pointed heart. Keep recognizable vanilla top-left shine structure.
